answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Sworn rabbi ordination with rabbinical council attestation. It requires an ordination the council renews after congregational audits, so the grove of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the cipher first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The jetty is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
